Location:  Dalhart, TX
Job Id:  218 # of Openings:  1

Job Description: The Healthcare Culinary Director provides leadership and oversight for culinary, food service, and hospitality operations throughout the healthcare organization. This position is responsible for creating an exceptional dining experience for patients, residents, employees, guests, and visitors while ensuring all food service operations meet healthcare regulatory, nutritional, sanitation, safety, and quality standards.

The Healthcare Culinary Director combines healthcare knowledge, culinary expertise, and hospitality leadership to develop a food service program that reflects the organization's commitment to exceptional care. The Director is expected to lead with a strong service mindset, recognizing that food, presentation, hospitality, and personal interaction are important components of the overall patient and resident experience.
 
Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
 
Leadership and Operations
  • Provides overall leadership and direction for Culinary Services and Food & Nutrition operations across the organization.
  • Oversee daily food preparation, meal service, dining operations, staffing, scheduling, purchasing, inventory, sanitation, and department workflow.
  • Develops and maintains efficient department processes while ensuring high standards for food quality, presentation, consistency, safety, and service.
  • Provides visible, hands-on leadership and maintains an active presence within culinary operations and dining areas.
  • Recruits, trains, develops, evaluates, and supports culinary and food service team members.
  • Establishes clear performance expectations and promotes accountability, teamwork, professionalism, and excellent customer service.
  • Works collaboratively with nursing, clinical leadership, administration, dietitians, long-term care leadership, and other departments to ensure culinary services support the needs of patients and residents.
Culinary Excellence
  • Provides culinary leadership in menu development, food preparation, presentation, quality, and consistency.
  • Develops menus that balance nutrition, clinical requirements, resident and patient preferences, food quality, variety, presentation, and cost effectiveness.
  • Promote fresh, appealing, high-quality meals appropriate for a healthcare environment.
  • Ensures standardized recipes, portion controls, production standards, and appropriate food preparation techniques are consistently followed.
  • Evaluates opportunities to enhance menus, special events, holiday meals, employee dining, catering, and resident dining experiences.
  • Maintains awareness of culinary trends and identifies appropriate opportunities to improve healthcare dining services.
Healthcare and Regulatory Compliance
 
  • Ensure food service operations comply with applicable federal, state, and local requirements, including healthcare, long-term care, food safety, sanitation, infection prevention, and life safety standards applicable to the organization.
